distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the causal clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: The parcel label and the account both show my current address.
clue_answer: the label matched the current address
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I cannot confirm whether every address record is current.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, a parcel of mine says it could not be delivered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can check that. Do you have the tracking reference?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it begins with seven-seven-four.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The delivery run succeeds only when the parcel label matches the current account address; a mismatch sends it back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Understood; I compared the label with the account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Has this happened with earlier parcels?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not that I can recall.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the contact number ending in two-nine-five current?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is the right number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like notifications by message?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that would be useful.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Was anybody at home during the attempt?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I was in all afternoon.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would a neighbour accept the parcel for you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, the one next door usually would.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there a secure porch or side entrance?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There is a porch, yes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does the address printed on the parcel match the current account address?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The parcel label and the account both show my current address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the parcel time-sensitive at all?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Somewhat, I need it this week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did the courier leave a card of any kind?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I did not find one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would a collection point be acceptable instead?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, if it is nearby.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Book the parcel onto the next available delivery run.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will see what comes of it.

user_action.observation: While you were unavailable, I had the parcel destination corrected to match the current account address.

shipment_status.at_facility: the shipment is held at a carrier facility
shipment_status.out_for_delivery: the shipment is on an active delivery run
shipment_status.returned_to_sender: delivery failed and the shipment is being sent back

causal_alignment.misaligned: the parcel label contains an outdated destination
causal_alignment.aligned: the parcel label matches the current destination

pre_gap_actions.description: Book the parcel onto the next available delivery run.
Open a loss claim before another attempt is made.
Send out replacement goods straight away.
Ring the depot before arranging anything else.
Close the request and ask the user to track it themselves.

post_gap_actions.description: Update the stored destination details before booking another run.
Book the parcel onto another delivery run right now.
Ring the depot about the parcel.
Leave the booking alone and wait another interval.
Conclude that the completed operation succeeded, then close the request.

causal_post_gap_observation.text: Forty minutes have passed and the delivery run ended, but tracking no longer shows the outcome. Based on the address detail I gave earlier, what should happen next?

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: Does the address printed on the parcel match the current account address?
questions.gold_answer: the label matched the current address

questions.question: Was anyone at home for the attempt?
Where did the parcel end up?

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
